title: A Content and Product Partnership with Vox Media
summary: In a multi-faceted agreement, Vox Media’s content will enhance the output of OpenAI’s ChatGPT, and the company will build on OpenAI’s technology to develop products to better serve its audiences and advertisers.
body: In a multi-faceted agreement, Vox Media’s content will enhance the output of OpenAI’s ChatGPT, and the company will build on OpenAI’s technology to develop products to better serve its audiences and advertisers.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Vox Media达成多维度合作协议。Vox Media的内容将用于增强ChatGPT的输出质量，同时Vox Media将利用OpenAI的技术开发服务于其受众和广告商的新产品。此举不仅丰富了ChatGPT的数据来源，也展示了媒体公司如何通过集成大模型技术实现业务转型与产品创新，是AI与媒体行业深度整合的又一重要案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与Vox Media的合作进一步扩大了其在媒体内容生态中的布局。

glossary.explanationZh: 涵盖内容授权、技术开发等多方面的综合性协议。
利用高质量外部数据提升模型输出的准确性和相关性。
